_provenance.note: Hand-authored from the documented GitHub Actions 'List workflow runs for a workflow' response shape (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/workflow-runs#list-workflow-runs-for-a-workflow), trimmed to the fields realPostMergeCiProbe consumes (status, conclusion, id, updated_at, html_url). API-ordered newest-first: a NON-TERMINAL run (status in_progress, conclusion null — the documented shape while a run has not finished) ahead of a completed successful one. This is the common live shape, not an exotic one: governance-postmerge.yml triggers on push to main, so any status read shortly after a merge sees the in-flight run first. The fixture exists to pin the find-first-COMPLETED filter — without it the probe reads runs[0], carries conclusion null into the evaluator, and reports uncomputable on a perfectly readable ledger.
